speaker: Doctor
text: I understand you are experiencing fatigue, difficulty concentrating, and have abnormal blood findings. To begin our evaluation, how long have these symptoms been present, and have you noticed any changes in your weight or appetite recently?

speaker: Patient
text: 53-year-old male. The patient has a 3-week history of fatigue, difficulty to concentrate, and dyspnea on exertion. He also experiences dizziness and digital pain that improves with cold. He has a long history of smoking.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for the details. Your symptoms of digital pain relieved by cold and dizziness are highly suggestive of Raynaud's phenomenon; given your 3-week history of fatigue, dyspnea, and smoking history, have you noticed any color changes in your fingers or toes when exposed to cold or stress? Also, do you have any history of joint pain or swelling?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Fatigue and difficulty to concentrate. I also have Dyspnea on exertion, Dizziness, Digital pain that improves with cold.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Systemic Sclerosis (Scleroderma Spectrum Disorder)

Your symptoms of fatigue, dyspnea, dizziness, and digital pain relieved by cold, combined with your smoking history, strongly suggest systemic sclerosis with Raynaud's phenomenon. Have you noticed thickening or tightness of the skin on your hands or face, or any difficulty opening your mouth?
